approved_by: Omri, 2026-09-24: does tail-fitted L-SML also work for bank11 and for the CT7 channels (instead of their current rule)?

banks.B11: bank11 step channels (pool columns 0-10); native signs (label-free) and PRMBench-AUC-oriented variant
banks.CT7s: the 7 CT7 channels as STEP-level pool columns (ct7_H0lim, ct7_ve0, ct7_ve0.75, ct7_ve1, ct7_H0lim_prefix_innovation, ct7_bocpd_residual, ct7_chosen_std_excess), native signs. NOTE: frozen CT7 fuses these at TOKEN level (declared 4/2/1 block-equal) then reads out steps; the step-level rows are a matched re-implementation, and the frozen ct7 score is shown beside them

rules.block421: CT7s only: declared 4/2/1 partition {H0lim, ve0, ve0.75, ve1} / {prefix_innovation, bocpd_residual} / {chosen_std_excess}, block-equal
rules.cov_lsml: continuous L-SML on the continuous channels (current rule)
rules.tail20_lsml / tail1_lsml: continuous L-SML fitted on per-answer top-20% (or argmax) indicators of each channel, centred within answer; weights applied to the continuous channels; oriented by Spearman with q15_H1 (B11) or ct7_H0lim (CT7s)
